audit.whatIsWrong: Six strings called his poke 'Q and W' or 'Q/W poke'. Going Rogue (W) is the Scoundrel/camouflage ability — it deals no poke damage at all. One string also said he swings his E 'off minions/walls'; Heroic Swing hooks terrain only. Dirty Fighting's shield was never mentioned.

His only ranged damage is Avengerang (Q, 9s at rank 1), autos, and Comeuppance. Every third hit from attacks and abilities shields him off a champion — that shield eats the burst window Poppy needs.
audit.corrected: Poke attributed to Avengerang (Q) only, W left as the roam/camouflage threat it already is elsewhere, the hook restricted to terrain, and the Dirty Fighting shield named as something to force out first.

edits.before: Akshan wants to poke you with Q and W and swing his E grapple to keep distance, but the second that swing drops him into melee range you E him into the nearest wall for a hard stun and a max-HP Q chunk — that is the whole early game. At Levels 1-2 just last-hit and eat a little Q poke; you have the sustain-through-tankiness to ignore it. From Level 3 his grapple is your bait: hold W and the instant he commits the swing toward you, ground it and slam him into terrain.
edits.after: Akshan pokes with Avengerang (Q) every 9s and hooks Heroic Swing into terrain to keep distance, but the second that swing drops him into melee you E him into the nearest wall for a hard stun and a max-HP Q chunk — that is the whole early game. At Levels 1-2 last-hit and eat the boomerang; force out his Dirty Fighting shield before you commit. From Level 3 the grapple is your bait: hold W, and the instant he swings toward you, stop it and slam him into terrain.

notes: Going Rogue (W) was being sold as poke in six places — it is the Scoundrel mark plus camouflage/move-speed roam tool and does no lane damage. Fixed where it appeared as damage; left intact where the text already treats it as a roam threat. Also corrected the claim that Heroic Swing can be swung off minions: Riot's text says it fires a grappling hook into terrain. I did not repeat the mirror's 'Comeuppance scales up to 200% with missing HP' figure — it is not in the kit file and I could not verify it.
